items.title: The field, in yards
items.caption: Drawn straight from the code's field model: 120 yards including end zones, 53.3 yards wide, hash marks 23.58 yards in from each sideline. Every landmark here is a point the camera image will be pinned to.

items.title: 419 camera cuts in 96 minutes of film
items.caption: How long each camera take lasts, and the 'tilt' signal that separates sideline from end-zone angles. Real measurements from the demo game. The tilt is bimodal on purpose: sideline takes read near 88 degrees, end-zone takes near 47.

items.title: 184 plays, laid out on the film's clock
items.caption: Each bar is one play, coloured by type, placed where it sits in the film. The count matched the official play-by-play exactly, which nothing in the code arranged. It fell out.

items.title: Overlay video: boxes and tracks on the broadcast frame
items.caption: Ten plays with stable player ids and team colours. Arrives with milestone 3.

items.title: The bird's-eye view
items.caption: Every player as a dot on the field, from above, at full frame rate. The first thing the camera never showed us. Arrives with milestone 4.

items.title: Free-camera 3D replay
items.caption: Fly the camera behind the quarterback or above the safeties. Arrives with milestone 8.
